summary: Frontend-only regression test for Search → Discover → Feed handoff was executed on mobile web preview. Code-level checks pass for question_id-based wiring and in-place feed reordering, but live tap flow could not be fully validated because Discover list stayed empty in UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Discover area renders empty state ('There are no questions to discover yet.') even when feed has at least one visible quiz card, so DiscoverCard tap path cannot be exercised.

integration_issues.flow: Search overlay -> Discover card tap -> open same question on current feed
integration_issues.issue: Blocked in live test because no discover-card elements were rendered (count remained 0 after explicit wait).

react_native_issues.issue: Console still reports deprecated RN-web warnings: shadow* and pointerEvents props.

action_items: Fix Discover data source/loading so discover cards appear when feed has available published questions.
After Discover cards render, retest tap flow to verify: overlay closes, no route change, selected question becomes first feed card, and swipe continues normally.
Keep current question_id-based wiring; do not reintroduce text/index based mapping or new routes.
critical_code_review_comments: DiscoverCard is correctly Pressable and calls onQuestionOpen with full question object keyed by question.question_id.
Feed openDiscoverQuestion implementation correctly closes panel, removes duplicates by question_id, prepends selected question, and scrolls existing FlatList to offset 0.
No new route was introduced for Discover handoff in referenced files; behavior is implemented in-place on current feed screen.

SearchPanel currently loads Discover via independent fetchFeed(12) instead of using existing feed questions prop; this can diverge from visible feed state and cause empty Discover while feed has content.

success_rate.frontend: 65% (code-path checks passed, live Discover tap flow blocked by empty Discover list)

seed_data_creation: No test users/questions/data were created or modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use existing data only (no seed creation). First confirm Discover cards render in Search overlay, then run Discover tap assertion against first feed card testID (quiz-card-{question_id}).
rca_of_issue: Repro: login as guest -> feed loads with quiz-card visible -> tap header-search -> Discover section shows empty state and zero discover-card items even after wait. Likely root cause is data-source divergence or fetch failure in SearchPanel Discover fetch path (fetchFeed(12)) versus already-populated feed questions state.
